name: portparity
description: Behavior-preserving code migration: run the original and the replacement on the same inputs, shrink mismatches, and report exactly what still differs.

interface.shortDescription: Prove a port behaves like the original, case by case
interface.longDescription: Wrap the original and the replacement in small adapters, run both on the same JSON cases, shrink every kind of mismatch to a minimal regression case, and get an evidence report that states exactly what was tested.
defaultPrompt: Port this function to Python and use portparity to check it matches the original.
Use portparity to find where the new implementation differs from the legacy one.
